heterogeneity.note: Segment levels x 2 arms x 2 outcomes are all pre-specified but cell-level CATEs are NOT multiplicity-adjusted; about 5% would look nominally significant by chance. Interaction (heterogeneity) tests are BH/Holm-adjusted across the 24 variable-level tests.

uplift.note: Qini coefficient = area between the Qini curve and the random-targeting line (units: incremental outcome per customer; visit = incremental visit probability). 'Random' = shuffled scores; its mean~0 and sd show the noise floor. Best learner is selected on these same holdouts (3 candidates), so its mean is mildly optimistic.

policy.method_note: Incremental profit per 1,000 customers vs emailing nobody, on holdout, using arm-matching with known 1/3 assignment probability (self-normalised IPW). Bootstrap CIs resample holdout customers on split 0 (paired across policies); the across-split mean +/- sd shows sensitivity to the random split. Costs/margins are illustrative assumptions, not data.
